title: Normal force at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at point B using Newton's second law and the speed from energy conservation.

title: Cart length from work-energy
description: Essential: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem to find the speed at the cart's end, leading to the cart length L.

title: Initial velocity for projectile
description: Essential: Correctly determines the required initial velocity at A for the block to land at the barrier base when the cart is removed.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy to relate speed at A and B, or to find v_B.

title: Projectile motion kinematics
description: Important: Correctly uses kinematic equations for vertical fall and horizontal motion to find time of flight and horizontal distances.

title: Geometric relationship setup
description: Important: Establishes the correct equation linking the cart length L, the projectile range x, and the total distance to the barrier (2.4 m).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds, Newtons) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the work done by friction in the work-energy theorem.

title: Forgetting centripetal force
description: Pitfall: Omits the centripetal force term (m v^2/R) when calculating the normal force at point B.
